name: talpy-den
description: Every Claude Code chat on this computer and your SSH hosts in one view: who needs you, plan usage, subagents, and Talpy, the animated pet. Runs on your side, also in Remote-SSH windows.

talpy-den-working.description: Talpy Den: chats at work (the status bar)

talpy-den-waiting.description: Talpy Den: a chat needs you (the status bar)

talpy-den-idle.description: Talpy Den: your turn in a chat (the status bar)

talpy-den-none.description: Talpy Den: no chat running (the status bar)

editor/title.when: resourceScheme == file && (resourcePath =~ /\/\.claude[^/]*\/plans\/[^/]+\.md$/ || resourceExtname == .md && resourceDirname in talpyDen.planFolders)

talpyDen.recentChats.markdownDescription: How many recent chats each account lists at a time: **Show N more** under them lists the next ones (0: none). ★ Starred chats and plans, and an opened project's chats, plans and memories, show as many at a time (5 with 0).

talpyDen.keepDoneHours.markdownDescription: Keep finished background chats listed for this many hours (0 = drop them right away).

talpyDen.showTokens.markdownDescription: Show today's and this week's token totals per account.

talpyDen.showUsageInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the 5-hour plan usage next to the status bar item.

enumDescriptions: Open chats in VS Code's terminal (on the right machine: here, or the host this window is connected to).
Open chats in your desktop's terminal app, as Talpy Den does on Plasma and GNOME.
talpyDen.openIn.markdownDescription: Where chats open when you click them.

enumDescriptions: Open chats in Talpy Chat: a chat that isn't running opens in its tab, and your next message goes on with it in the background; you answer Claude's prompts there. A background chat no terminal shows opens there too. This computer's chats only: an SSH host's or a container's open in a terminal.
Reopen chats that aren't running in a terminal (claude --resume), as `#talpyDen.openIn#` says.
Reopen chats that aren't running in a Claude Code panel, in the VS Code window that has the chat's folder (on an SSH host's chats: connected to it).
talpyDen.reopenIn.markdownDescription: Where chats open: the **Talpy Chat | Terminal | Claude Code panel** switch above Recent chats. It holds for chats that aren't running (from their row, their tab's **Open its window** and Find a Chat) and, with Talpy Chat, for a background chat no terminal shows (its pet, its row, its notifications). **New Chat…** lists **In a Talpy Chat tab** first. Without a `claude` command they reopen in Claude Code.

talpyDen.clickOpensPane.markdownDescription: A click on a chat opens it in Talpy Chat, an editor tab: its conversation as it goes, a box to reply, what it asks for (Allow / Deny), and what it changed (Undo, Commit, Mark reviewed). Off: a click opens the chat itself, as `#talpyDen.openIn#` says (the tab is then a button beside it).

enumDescriptions: Each chat in an editor tab of its own.

In Talpy Chat's view in the secondary side bar, beside Claude Code's and Copilot's chats, where no file opens over it: one chat at a time, the next one you open takes its place (VS Code 1.106 or later; an older one opens tabs).
talpyDen.chatPlace.markdownDescription: Where Talpy Chat shows a chat: in an editor **tab** of its own, or in its view in the secondary **side bar** (one chat at a time). You can drag that view to another place, as any view.

talpyDen.newChatModel.markdownDescription: The model new chats in a terminal or in the background start with (`claude --model`; **New Chat…** changes it). Not for a Claude Code panel: that has its own model setting.

talpyDen.newChatEffort.markdownDescription: The reasoning effort new chats in a terminal or in the background start with (`claude --effort`; **New Chat…** changes it).

talpyDen.newChatMode.markdownDescription: The permission mode new chats in a terminal or in the background start in (`claude --permission-mode`; **New Chat…** changes it, Shift+Tab in the chat too). A background chat can start in auto mode or bypass permissions only once you turned that on in a terminal.

talpyDen.diffSideBySide.markdownDescription: Show a change in Talpy Chat side by side (before | after) where its tab is wide enough, else removed and added lines one after the other. The switch in a change's corner sets it too.

talpyDen.chatTextScale.markdownDescription: Text size in Talpy Chat, times VS Code's font size. Its A− / A+ buttons and Ctrl+wheel change it.

enumDescriptions: The integrated terminal's font (else the editor's), as Claude's terminal shows a chat
talpyDen.chatFont.markdownDescription: The font of Talpy Chat: the conversation and your reply.

talpyDen.suggestReplies.markdownDescription: Suggest replies in Talpy Chat: once Claude's turn is over, small chips above the box answer the question it ended with (its options, Yes or No…) or offer what you usually reply after a turn that ended the same way (a usage limit, a chat that stopped…), and what you type is completed in grey (Tab or → takes it). Nothing is sent without a click. Worked out on this computer, from your own chats on the chat's account; off, nothing is read for it. A chip's right-click menu hides one of your usual replies for good; **Talpy Den: Suggest Hidden Replies Again** brings them back.

talpyDen.dictateLanguage.markdownDescription: The language you dictate replies in, as a code (`en`, `de`, `fr`…), or `auto` to let whisper tell. Dictating (the microphone in Talpy Chat) runs on this computer: the first click offers to set it up (faster-whisper, no sudo), and **Talpy Den: Dictation Models…** downloads, deletes or picks the speech model. What you say never leaves the computer.

enumItemLabels: Talpy Den, keeping what you starred
markdownEnumDescriptions: When it starts, Claude Code deletes every chat, and every plan of an account's plans folder, older than its `cleanupPeriodDays` (30 days unless set): starred or not, for good.

Once a day Talpy Den deletes the chats you haven't used for **Old Chats Days**, with their undo history and files, and finished background chats; old plans go to the Trash. What you starred stays, and so do chats that are open, queued or keep going, and a plan while its chat stays. Meanwhile Claude Code's own cleanup is off on every account, here and on the SSH hosts and containers shown (`cleanupPeriodDays` 3650); choosing it again puts it back.
talpyDen.oldChats.markdownDescription: Who deletes old chats and plans. Choosing Talpy Den first says what its first run deletes and asks. One choice for Talpy Den here and on Plasma or GNOME; **Talpy Den: Old Chats** shows its last runs and what its next one would delete.

talpyDen.oldChatsDays.markdownDescription: With **Old Chats** set to Talpy Den: the days a chat you haven't used stays. Fewer days are asked first, with what the next run deletes.

talpyDen.notifyWaiting.markdownDescription: Notify when a chat needs your input. (If Talpy Den runs on Plasma or GNOME too, turn this off in one of them.)

talpyDen.notifyDone.markdownDescription: Notify when a chat finishes a turn that took at least `#talpyDen.notifyDoneMinSeconds#` seconds.

talpyDen.notifyDoneMinSeconds.markdownDescription: Shortest turn, in seconds, that gets a "finished" notification.

talpyDen.notifySound.markdownDescription: Play a sound with notifications (Linux: PipeWire, PulseAudio or ALSA; nothing plays while Do Not Disturb is on).

talpyDen.soundWaiting.markdownDescription: Sound when a chat needs you: sound-theme names (comma-separated, the first one found plays) or a sound file.

talpyDen.soundFailed.markdownDescription: Sound when a chat fails, or a usage limit or an expired login stops it.

talpyDen.awayDigest.markdownDescription: When you come back to VS Code after `#talpyDen.awayMinutes#` minutes or more, one notification sums up what happened meanwhile (chats that finished, failed or need you, limits that reset). While you're away, notifications of finished chats wait for it.

talpyDen.awayMinutes.markdownDescription: How long, in minutes, no VS Code window has to be in use to count as away (`#talpyDen.awayDigest#`).

talpyDen.usageCap.markdownDescription: A usage cap, in percent (0 = none): once one of an account's plan windows (5 hours, a week) reaches it, the account's chats at work on this computer are stopped, once in that window (in tmux and in a Claude Code panel the turn is interrupted, the chat stays open). Queued tasks wait until the window resets, and chats that keep going go on then. Chats you start or answer yourself afterwards aren't stopped again.

talpyDen.usageRefreshMinutes.markdownDescription: Claude's own VS Code panel runs no status line, so its chats don't bring an account's plan usage up to date. While one of an account's chats works and its numbers are this many minutes old, Claude Code fetches them, as its `/usage` does (no tokens, no chat saved), at most this often; also on SSH hosts. 0: never.

talpyDen.playfulTalpy.markdownDescription: Playful Talpy: his tricks and props, jokes, cookies and games. Off, he only shows what your chats do: his moods, his lamp and quiet moves (looking around, typing, thinking, sleeping). Notifications and the badge stay as they are.

talpyDen.chatPets.markdownDescription: Pets for each account's chats, one for each running chat, at most this many (0: only the big Talpy).

talpyDen.mondayRecap.markdownDescription: On Mondays (from 9 o'clock, or the first time VS Code runs after that), a notification sums up the last 7 days; **Open the Recap** shows them. It comes once a week, here or on Plasma.

talpyDen.recapCurrency.markdownDescription: The currency of the Recap tab's amounts. Claude's API prices are in US dollars; for another currency the Recap tab downloads the European Central Bank's reference rates of the day from ecb.europa.eu, at most every 6 hours and only while the tab is open (offline it uses the last rates it has). Nothing about your chats is sent.

talpyDen.recapHistory.markdownDescription: Claude Code deletes chats after 30 days (its `cleanupPeriodDays` setting). The Recap tab's **Overall** keeps their numbers past that, in `~/.cache/talpy-den`: times, tokens, costs, folders and chat names; and your plan's windows that ended, for 90 days. Off, it keeps only what Claude still has. One choice for Talpy Den here and on Plasma or GNOME. **Talpy Den: Delete the Recap's Saved History…** deletes it.

talpyDen.recapRules.markdownDescription: The Permissions tab suggests rules that would have let the permission prompts you answered go without asking, each with an **Allow** button. Off, it only counts the prompts, and there's nothing to allow by mistake. Either way it lists the permissions you gave, to revoke them.

talpyDen.sshHosts.markdownDescription: SSH hosts (names from `~/.ssh/config`) whose Claude Code chats are shown too. Use **Talpy Den: Show Claude on SSH Hosts and Containers…** to pick them (and containers: `docker:NAME`, `podman:NAME`, `nerdctl:NAME`, or `ENGINE:NAME@HOST` for one on an SSH host). Needs key-based login, or **Log in…** where the host wants a password (Talpy Den never sees it), and `python3` 3.7+ on the host; nothing is installed there.

talpyDen.includeCurrentRemote.markdownDescription: In a Remote-SSH window, also show the chats of the host the window is connected to.

talpyDen.remotePollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often SSH hosts are checked, in seconds.

enumDescriptions: Once per account: an account logged in on this computer and on a host (or on two hosts) has one plan usage, shown where the account is listed first, with the newest numbers of them all.
On every host: each machine's own numbers, under each copy of the account.
Not on hosts: no SSH host's account shows plan usage.
talpyDen.sshUsage.markdownDescription: Plan usage on SSH hosts' accounts.

talpyDen.showContainers.markdownDescription: Show Docker, Podman and nerdctl containers (here and on the SSH hosts shown) in **Talpy Den: Show Claude on SSH Hosts and Containers…**. One you pick shows like a host: Talpy Den works in it with the engine's exec, and it needs `python3` there. Off, Talpy Den never runs `docker`, `podman` or `nerdctl`.

talpyDen.containerDays.markdownDescription: The containers listed: the running ones and those started or stopped in the last this many days (0: only the running ones). One you picked is always listed.

talpyDen.pollInterval.markdownDescription: While a chat works, how often this computer's chats are checked while the view is open, in milliseconds: how often a working chat's line (what it's doing) is brought up to date (every 10 s while the view is hidden, 6 s at most often in a window that isn't focused). **No effect with Live Mode… on:** a working chat's steps show as they happen then, and it's checked every 6 s. A chat that starts, ends, starts working, asks for something or finishes its turn is checked the moment it does, either way.

talpyDen.idlePollInterval.markdownDescription: While no chat works, how often this computer's chats are checked, in milliseconds: for what changes while no chat does anything (plan usage and its forecast, a usage limit resetting, a queued task coming due, a Claude that crashed). Without Live Mode, never more often than `#talpyDen.pollInterval#`. A chat that changes is checked at once anyway.

talpyDen.extraConfigDirs.markdownDescription: More Claude Code config folders to read. `~/.claude`, every `~/.claude-*` folder and `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` are found without this.

talpyDen.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.7+ used to read Claude Code's files on this computer.
